title: Open Logix repo metadata
description: What an Open Logix repo is, for the org's tools (its type and where its issues go): .github/logix-repo-metadata.jsonc in each repo, changed only by pull request. repos-janitor reads it. The file is JSONC: comments say why.

type.description: The repo type, which decides its release policy (Repo types, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md): installable (a product people install, from its release marked Latest; also when programs download it too), dependency (data or tools programs download, as remote configs name them) or no-releases (it's only read: no releases at all).

issues.description: Where this repo's problems and ideas are reported (Contact and GitHub features, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md): here (the repo takes issues: only the products people use directly, Logix IDE and Logix Engine), or the repo that takes them for it, such as openlogix/logix-engine, which its README links.
